topic.name: 摩擦力测量实验
topic.title: 木块还没动，摩擦力为什么已经变了？
topic.question: 木块还没动，摩擦力为什么已经变了？
topic.description: 匀速拖动比较压力，再用纸团峰值和力传感器跟踪静止到滑动的全过程。
topic.tag: 静止 · 起滑 · 匀速

translations.木块还没动，摩擦力为什么已经变了？: Why does friction change before the block moves?
translations.匀速拖动比较压力，再用纸团峰值和力传感器跟踪静止到滑动的全过程。: Compare normal loads at steady speed, then track breakaway with a peak marker and a force sensor.
translations.用更大的压力，比较滑动时的阻碍: Press harder and compare sliding resistance
translations.保持匀速，再比较不同压力: Keep speed steady before comparing normal loads
translations.拉力增大，木块还没有滑动: Pull increases while the block stays still
translations.刚开始滑动后，读数降向滑动摩擦力: After breakaway, the reading approaches kinetic friction
translations.手压桌面 · 示意体验: Hand on a table · Illustrative experience
translations.接触面、木块或手、拉力测量装置随模型状态变化: A contact surface, block or hand and force instrument follow the model state
translations.纸团留下最大读数，指针可以回落: The paper keeps the peak while the pointer returns
translations.同一过程，传感器保留整个力—时间曲线: A sensor records the full force–time history
translations.拉力先增加到静摩擦上限，滑动后逐渐降向滑动摩擦力: Pull rises to the static threshold, then approaches sliding friction after breakaway
translations.手压得更紧，接触面的正压力增加，滑动阻碍随之增大。: Pressing harder raises normal load and the resistance to sliding.
translations.匀速时合力为零，所以测力计读数等于滑动摩擦力。: At constant speed the net force is zero, so the reading equals kinetic friction.
translations.刚滑动时有加速度，瞬时拉力并不立即等于滑动摩擦力。: The block accelerates just after breakaway; pull does not immediately equal kinetic friction.
translations.静摩擦力随拉力调整；没有滑动时不应总写成最大值。: Static friction adjusts with pull; it is not always at its maximum.
translations.接触材料相同，在此模型中滑动摩擦力与正压力成正比。: For the same materials, this model makes kinetic friction proportional to normal load.
translations.镜头跟随接触物体；滑动时桌纹向后移动。静、动摩擦因数取0.45和0.30，忽略材: The camera follows the contact object; table marks move backward during sliding. Static and kinetic coefficients are 0.45 and 0.30; speed effects are omitted.

cues.title: 先保证匀速
cues.caption: 匀速水平拖动时，拉力等于滑动摩擦力。
cues.captionEn: A steady horizontal pull equals kinetic friction.
cues.zh: 把木块放在水平桌面上，用测力计沿水平方向匀速拉动。镜头跟着木块，所以桌面纹理向后移动。匀速是这一测量的重要条件：加速度为零，水平方向的拉力和摩擦力大小相等，读数才可以代表滑动摩擦力。如果木块正在明显加速，就不能直接这样读数。
cues.en: Pull a block horizontally at steady speed. The view follows the block, so the table marks move backward. Constant speed matters: zero acceleration means the horizontal pull balances friction, allowing the meter to measure kinetic friction. A clearly accelerating block would not satisfy that reading rule.

cues.title: 增加正压力
cues.caption: 材料相同，增加载荷后摩擦力增大。
cues.captionEn: For the same surfaces, added load increases friction.
cues.zh: 保持相同接触材料与匀速拉动方式，在木块上加砝码。桌面承受的正压力增加，测力计的读数也增大。在这里的干摩擦模型中，正压力翻倍，滑动摩擦力也翻倍。我们改变的是压紧程度，而不是把木块拉得更快；比较时要把这两个条件分清。
cues.en: Keep the surfaces and steady pulling method unchanged, and add a mass. The normal load rises, as does the force reading. In this dry-friction model, doubling normal load doubles kinetic friction. We changed how strongly the surfaces press together, not how quickly the block is pulled; keep these conditions separate.

cues.title: 用手体验压力变化
cues.caption: 按压更大时，滑动的阻碍更明显。
cues.captionEn: Stronger pressure produces more sliding resistance.
cues.zh: 换成手压桌面的体验。手沿桌面滑动，同时改变向下的压力，就能比较压紧程度对滑动阻碍的影响。这里的数字仍然来自模型，并不是对真实手感的测量。这个小活动和木块实验有相同的控制思路：接触材料不变，专门改变正压力，再观察或感受摩擦的变化。
cues.en: Try the related hand-on-table activity. Move the hand while changing downward pressure to compare sliding resistance. These numerical values remain model predictions, not measurements of a real sensation. Like the block experiment, the comparison keeps the contact materials fixed and changes normal load.

cues.title: 留下起滑峰值
cues.caption: 静摩擦随拉力增加，纸团保留最大读数。
cues.captionEn: Static friction grows with pull; the paper keeps the peak.
cues.zh: 现在从静止开始，缓慢增大拉力。木块还没动，静摩擦力已经随着拉力一起增大，并不是始终等于一个固定最大值。到达起滑边界之后，木块开始运动，读数向下回落。小纸团留下刚才的最大位置，指针可以返回。注意刚起滑时还有加速度，要到接近匀速时，拉力才接近滑动摩擦力。
cues.en: Start from rest and gradually increase the pull. Static friction grows with it while the block remains still; it is not always a fixed maximum. At the breakaway threshold, motion begins and the reading falls. The paper keeps the highest position while the pointer returns. Immediately after breakaway the block accelerates, so pull approaches kinetic friction only as the speed settles.

cues.title: 看完整时间记录
cues.caption: 传感器同时保留增长、峰值和回落。
cues.captionEn: The sensor preserves the rise, peak and falling reading.
cues.zh: 用力传感器重新观察同一个过程。曲线先随时间上升，在起滑附近达到峰值，再降向较低的稳定读数。它比一个最大值保留了更多过程信息。暂停在不同位置，把曲线、木块运动和仪器读数相互核对。最大静摩擦力与滑动摩擦力是不同概念，不能把静止阶段全部涂成峰值。
cues.en: A force sensor records the same process continuously: a rising force, a peak around breakaway, then a lower steady reading. It retains more information than a maximum alone. Pause at different times and compare graph, block motion and instrument reading. Maximum static friction and kinetic friction are distinct; the whole stationary interval must not be represented by the peak value.
